title: Zorvyn Admin — E-commerce Admin Dashboard
summary: An admin panel for the Zorvyn store with light and dark themes: animated sales charts (area, donut, bar), an order workflow with printable invoices, product and stock management, customers, reports with CSV export and settings.

images.alt: Zorvyn Admin dashboard in light mode with colourful stat tiles, an animated revenue trend and an orders-by-status donut chart
Zorvyn Admin dashboard in dark mode with sparklines, a revenue area chart and an orders-by-status donut chart
Zorvyn Admin reports in light mode with category and payment donut charts, revenue by weekday bars and top cities
Zorvyn Admin reports in dark mode with category and payment donut charts, revenue by weekday bars and top cities

caseStudy.overview: The back office for the Zorvyn demo store: everything a small online shop owner needs to run daily orders, stock and sales in one place.
caseStudy.problem: Small Bangladeshi shops often track orders in Facebook messages and stock in notebooks or spreadsheets, so orders get missed, popular sizes run out and nobody knows which products actually sell.
caseStudy.solution: A fast admin dashboard with sales numbers for any period, a clear order workflow (pending → confirmed → shipped → delivered, or cancelled with stock returned), product and size-level stock management with low-stock alerts, customer history, reports and Excel-ready CSV exports.
process: Mapped the shop owner's daily jobs: confirm orders, ship, restock, check sales
Generated 90 days of realistic demo orders in taka with Bangladeshi cities and payment methods
Built the dashboard, order workflow, product form with photo upload and inline stock editing
Drew animated, colour-blind-safe charts (area, donut, bar) with hover and keyboard tooltips and a table view
Tested every flow on phone and desktop in light and dark mode, and published on GitHub Pages

title: Tavique Fashion — Luxury Fashion Store
summary: An editorial luxury fashion store with campaign layouts, colour and size options, a size guide, a cart drawer, wishlist and a full demo checkout.

images.alt: Tavique Fashion home page with a large campaign photo and the headline “Designed to be worn with presence”
Tavique Fashion product page for a belted cotton trench with colour and size options

caseStudy.overview: The fashion storefront of Tavique, a multi-store e-commerce template, styled as an editorial luxury brand.
caseStudy.problem: Premium fashion brands need a store that feels like their lookbook, while still making sizes, stock and checkout clear.
caseStudy.solution: A calm, magazine-style layout with Bodoni and Jost type, warm neutrals and campaign sections, backed by URL-synced filters, variant-aware stock, a size guide, wishlist, discount codes and a validated demo checkout.
process: Defined the brand feel: editorial, quiet, premium
Built the theme, centred header and campaign homepage from a store config file
Added filters, product gallery with zoom, colour and size variants and a size guide
Built the cart drawer, discount codes, shipping options and a validated demo checkout
Tested on phone and desktop and published a static export on GitHub Pages

title: Tavique Electronics — Gadgets & Tech Store
summary: A search-first electronics store with spec details, storage and colour variants, light and dark themes, deals, a cart drawer and a full demo checkout.

images.alt: Tavique Electronics home page with a large search bar and an Arcline One Pro phone spotlight
Tavique Electronics product page for the Arcline One Pro with colour and storage options

caseStudy.overview: The electronics storefront of Tavique, built for shoppers who search first and compare specs before they buy.
caseStudy.problem: Tech shoppers know what they want and hate digging: they need fast search, clear specs and honest stock and price per option.
caseStudy.solution: A clean, technical layout in Geist type with graphite and blue, a search bar with suggestions and popular searches, category navigation, specs on every product, variant-aware pricing and stock, and a light/dark theme.
process: Mapped the shopping flow around search and comparison
Built the search-first header, category bar and deals sections
Added product specs, storage and colour variants with their own price and stock
Added a light and dark theme that remembers the visitor’s choice
Tested the full checkout on phone and desktop and published on GitHub Pages

title: Tavique Beauty — Skincare & Makeup Store
summary: A soft, refined beauty store with shop-by-concern tiles, a routine builder, shade options, journal content and a full demo checkout.

images.alt: Tavique Beauty home page with two Multi-Stick lipsticks and the headline “Clean colour, your way.”
Tavique Beauty product page for the Multi-Stick cheek and lip colour with shade options

caseStudy.overview: The beauty storefront of Tavique, designed to help shoppers find the right products for their skin and build a routine.
caseStudy.problem: Beauty shoppers shop by concern (dryness, dullness, fine lines), not by category, and need help choosing products that work together.
caseStudy.solution: A soft cream-and-blush design in Newsreader and Figtree type with shop-by-concern tiles, a routine builder, shade options on products, journal articles and the same fast cart and checkout as the other stores.
process: Organised the catalogue by skin concern as well as category
Designed a soft, refined theme with its own header and product cards
Built concern tiles, a routine builder and journal content
Added shade options, reviews and suggested products on every product page
Tested on phone and desktop and published on GitHub Pages

title: Zorvyn — Fashion E-commerce Store
summary: A responsive fashion store for sneakers, denim, women's and kids' wear: category filters, search, size charts, a saved shopping cart and a cash-on-delivery checkout with Dhaka delivery fees.

images.alt: Zorvyn store home page with a dark hero banner, sneaker and jeans photos
Zorvyn shop by category tiles for sneakers, jeans, women and kids, above the product grid

caseStudy.overview: A demo e-commerce store for a Bangladeshi fashion brand selling sneakers, denim, women's and kids' wear, built to show a complete shopping flow from browsing to order confirmation.
caseStudy.problem: Small fashion sellers often sell only through Facebook posts and inbox messages: customers can't browse sizes and prices easily, and every order needs manual back-and-forth.
caseStudy.solution: A fast, mobile-first store: products with sizes and sale prices, a cart that stays saved on the phone, and a checkout that checks the mobile number and adds the right delivery fee for inside or outside Dhaka.
process: Prepared square product photos and a simple product catalogue in taka
Designed a clean layout with one accent color and a clear path to checkout
Built filters, search, sorting, size selection and a saved cart in React and TypeScript
Added a checkout form with Bangladeshi mobile-number validation and delivery fees
Tested the full flow on phone and desktop and published it on GitHub Pages

title: Haatnest — Marketplace Landing Page
summary: An animated e-commerce marketplace landing page with live search, category filters, a flash-deal countdown and a working cart counter.

images.alt: Haatnest landing page hero with search bar, trending tags and floating deal cards
Haatnest flash deals grid with discount badges, countdown timer and add-to-cart buttons

caseStudy.overview: A concept landing page for a local online marketplace, built to show how motion and clear structure can make a shopping page feel alive.
caseStudy.problem: Marketplace homepages are often crowded: too many banners, no clear path from “browse” to “buy”, and weak performance on mobile.
caseStudy.solution: One focused page: a clear hero with search, category shortcuts, a filterable flash-deal grid, a simple “how it works” flow and a seller call-to-action.
process: Defined the page goal: get visitors searching or into deals within seconds
Designed a bold, outlined visual style with one accent color
Built lightweight CSS animations that respect reduced-motion settings
Added working search, filters, countdown and cart feedback in plain JavaScript
Tested on phone and desktop widths

title: Service Business Website
summary: A multi-section website for a local service business with service pages, trust signals and a simple booking inquiry flow.

caseStudy.overview: A sample website showing how a small service business can present its offer clearly and collect inquiries.
caseStudy.problem: Many small businesses rely only on social media pages, which makes services, prices and contact options hard to find.
caseStudy.solution: A fast, mobile-first site with clear service sections, FAQs and an inquiry form that opens WhatsApp or email with details prefilled.
process: Mapped the pages a customer actually needs
Wireframed the layout mobile-first
Built reusable components
Added SEO basics and deployed

title: Sales KPI Dashboard
summary: An Excel dashboard that turns a raw sales export into KPI cards, monthly trends and top-product views with slicers.

caseStudy.overview: A sample dashboard built from a dummy sales dataset to show a clean reporting layout.
caseStudy.problem: Sales data lived in long exports; building the monthly summary by hand took hours and was easy to get wrong.
caseStudy.solution: Power Query loads and shapes the export, pivot tables calculate the KPIs, and one dashboard sheet shows everything with slicers.
process: Listed the business questions first
Cleaned and modeled the data in Power Query
Built KPI cards, trend and ranking charts
Added a refresh guide

title: Monthly Report Automation
summary: A one-click workflow that merges several Excel files, applies formatting and calculations, and saves a ready-to-send report.

caseStudy.overview: A sample automation that replaces a repetitive monthly reporting routine.
caseStudy.problem: Copying data from several files, fixing formats and recalculating totals every month is slow and error-prone.
caseStudy.solution: A macro / script that collects the files, validates columns, builds the report and flags anything unusual for review.
process: Recorded the manual steps
Automated each step with checks
Added clear error messages
Wrote a short run guide

title: Product Catalog Data Cleaning
summary: A cleaning pipeline for a messy product sheet: duplicates, inconsistent units, mixed categories and missing fields.

caseStudy.overview: A sample cleaning job based on the kind of product data problems common in e-commerce catalogs.
caseStudy.problem: Duplicate rows, units written five different ways, wrong categories and blank required fields made the data unusable for reports or uploads.
caseStudy.solution: Rule-based cleaning steps plus a validation report listing every row that still needs a human decision.
process: Profiled the data to find issue types
Wrote reusable cleaning rules
Generated a validation report
Delivered clean file + rules

title: AI Product Content Workflow
summary: An AI-assisted workflow that drafts product titles and descriptions from a spreadsheet, with a human review step before publishing.

caseStudy.overview: A sample workflow showing how AI can speed up content work while a person stays in control.
caseStudy.problem: Writing consistent product content for many items by hand is slow, and quality varies between writers.
caseStudy.solution: Rows go from a sheet to an AI step with clear writing rules; drafts come back to the sheet for review and approval.
process: Defined content rules and examples
Built the sheet → AI → sheet loop
Added checks for length and banned words
Kept a human approval column
